==Overview== 
[[File:Elemental Type Chart.png|100px|thumb|left|Elemental type chart.]] The Rock type is one of the five elemental types found in Clash of Critters.

[[Critters]] and [[Zobos]] of the Rock type are weak to [[Grass]].

They are also super effective against [[Lightning]].
